fix_subject: Require full window ORDER BY match for peer-based ranking arg orders

labels.summary: RANK, PERCENT_RANK and CUME_DIST used the window ORDER BY peer boundaries whenever the argument ORDER BY was only a prefix of it, splitting rows that the argument order considers peers and producing wrong ranks; the fix uses the shared peer path only when the argument order covers the full window ORDER BY.
